leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a binary tree node class with value, left, and right properties
Implement a serialize function that converts a binary tree to a string representation
Apply a deserialize function that reconstructs a binary tree from its string representation
Manipulate tree traversal algorithms to generate and parse serialized data
Initialize test cases to validate serialization and deserialization functionality
Integrate error handling for edge cases like empty trees and invalid input
Configure a complete workflow that serializes and deserializes binary trees end-to-end
